summary:
Frontend-only verification of iteration 66 Aufmassprofi /sketches/draw. All 3 NEW features (opening presets Tür/Fenster/Eigenes Maß, polygon line numbers 1..n inside the lines, phone-only line-measure-scroll ScrollView body) verified live. Flow: dismissed disclaimer, drew closed 4-point polygon (200,350)(500,350)(500,600)(200,600), measured 3,62m / 2,91m / 3,62m / 2,91m via Edit tool + Nächste Linie. Regression `cd /app/frontend && npx tsx ../tests/e2e/iter64_wall_area.test.ts` prints OK / OK iter65 / OK html.

DIRECTLY VERIFIED (byte-for-byte spec match @ 768x1024 tablet):
1) Set wall-height-all='2,50m' on 3,62m line; clicked wall-opening-preset-door → width-0='0,885m', height-0='2,01m', wall-opening-area-0='= 1,78 m²', wall-line-area='Diese Linie: 7,27 m²' ✓ (spec 1,78 / 7,27).
2) Clicked wall-opening-preset-window → width-1='1,00m', height-1='1,20m', wall-opening-area-1='= 1,20 m²', wall-deduction-total='Abzug gesamt: 2,98 m²', wall-line-area='Diese Linie: 6,07 m²' ✓ (spec 1,20 / 2,98 / 6,07).
3) Edited door width to '1,00m' → wall-opening-area-0='= 2,01 m²' ✓ (spec 2,01 = 1,00×2,01).
4) wall-opening-add label is 'Eigenes Maß' (not 'Hinzufügen'); clicking it adds an empty row width-2='', height-2='' ✓.
5) wall-opening-remove-0 removes the first (door) row; index-0 now shows the window values width-0='1,00m', height-0='1,20m' ✓.
6) Preset buttons rendered side-by-side via presetRow {flexDirection:'row', gap:6} with label and size subtext ('Tür / 0,885 × 2,01' and 'Fenster / 1,00 × 1,20'); not clipped — screenshot /tmp/iter66_two_presets.png.

7) LINE NUMBERS in the editor: SVG circles with stroke #5d4037 counted via document.querySelectorAll('svg circle[stroke="#5d4037"]'):
   - 0 circles when polygon has no wall heights and no segment selected ✓
   - 4 circles when a segment is selected (no wall heights yet) ✓
   - 4 circles remain after setting wall-height-all='2,50m' and deselecting (panel closed) ✓
   Numbers 1-4 placed on the inside of each line (midpoint shifted toward centroid by 16px scaled by inverse zoom), no overlap with the outside measurement labels or the central S1 label — screenshot /tmp/iter66_measured.png shows the layout cleanly (1 top, 2 right, 3 bottom, 4 left).
   'Linie x von 4' label of the panel matches the circle number (selected bottom segment → 'Linie 3 von 4', circle 3 highlighted red) ✓.

8) SAVED PREVIEW SVG: pressed sketch-save-button (top-right check). Decoded data:image/svg+xml;base64 from localStorage['aufmassprofi_sketches'] via atob+decodeURIComponent: contains exactly 4 occurrences of stroke="#5d4037" AND matches regex /<circle[^>]*r="9"[^>]*stroke="#5d4037"/ → preview SVG renders the brown-stroked line-number circles for the polygon with wall heights ✓ (spec match for src/sketch/sketchSvg.ts:455-460 gated by hasWallHeights). Without wall heights the preview SVG would omit them (code path verified: sketchSvg.ts:455 `if (hasWallHeights(polygonWalls[el.id])) { ... }`).

9) TABLET layout: no [data-testid="line-measure-scroll"] element in DOM at 768x1024 ✓ (`MeasurePanelBody = isPhoneDevice ? ScrollView : View` at draw.tsx:7643). Numpad works, wall section scrolls internally (ScrollView maxHeight 300 from WallHeightSection.tsx:136).

10) PHONE layout (390x844): panel opened on bottom segment. [data-testid="line-measure-scroll"] IS present with bbox {x:204, y:193, width:176, height:529}. Added 3 opening rows via wall-opening-preset-door — body scrolls internally (scrollTop=400 confirmed, numbers / numpad / 'Abzug gesamt: 5,34 m²' reachable by scrolling). Screenshots /tmp/iter66_phone_panel_open.png, /tmp/iter66_phone_panel_openings.png, /tmp/iter66_phone_scrolled.png. Ton toggle AN verified. The spec's 'wall section's own scroll is disabled on phones' matches the code: WallHeightSection is passed `scrollable={!isPhoneDevice}` (not inspected via Playwright but code path at draw.tsx + WallHeightSection.tsx :67 `scrollEnabled={scrollable}` confirms it).

11) Regression unit tests: `cd /app/frontend && npx tsx ../tests/e2e/iter64_wall_area.test.ts` → prints 'OK' / 'OK iter65' / 'OK html'. No console.error / no pageerror / no red screen throughout. Only non-error console warning 'The action GO_BACK was not handled by any navigator' (dev-only, carry-over from iter 64/65, unrelated).

COVERED BY CODE REVIEW ONLY:
- Landscape phone 844x390 was not re-tested (viewport switch + redraw costly); the panel body is derived from `isPhoneDevice` (not from orientation), and `screenHeight` in the maxHeight formula is read live from `useWindowDimensions`, so in landscape maxHeight ≈ 390 - 190 = 200 — Cancel/Add should be reachable because body shrinks. Recommend main agent sanity-check on a real device.
- Zoom in/out behaviour of line-number circles: code at draw.tsx:5347-5357 scales both the circle radius (Math.max(5, 9/numberScale)) and the font size (Math.max(6, 10/numberScale)) inversely with zoom, so numbers stay readable. Not visually re-verified via Playwright.

ui_bugs.component: Floating line-measure panel @ 390x844 after adding 3 openings
ui_bugs.issue: With wall-section expanded + 3 opening rows, the panel's bottom Cancel/Add buttons extend past the 844-px viewport. Playwright bbox measurement: Cancel.bottom=864, Add.bottom=863 vs viewport 844 (both 19-20 px below the fold). The internal line-measure-scroll correctly scrolls the body, but the overall panel height (header + body + numpad + bottom buttons) still exceeds the viewport. Spec requirement 'the Cancel and Add/Done buttons of the panel remain visible at the bottom without scrolling the page' is not met in this state. See draw.tsx:7645 maxHeight formula `screenHeight - insets.top - insets.bottom - 190` — the 190 px reserve is insufficient when the numpad + bottom buttons occupy ~220 px. Suggest reducing maxHeight by ~40 px (e.g. subtract 220 instead of 190) or making the panel vertical-centered with a true sticky footer for Cancel/Add.

issues: Cancel/Add buttons no explicit testIDs (still relying on get_by_text('Cancel') / ('Add') — carry-over from iter 63/64/65).

(Carry-over) Give the Cancel / Add buttons explicit testIDs (e.g. line-measure-cancel-button, line-measure-done-button). arrow-tool-button testID still pending (iter 63).

critical_code_review_comments: /app/frontend/src/components/sketch/WallHeightSection.tsx:89-104 — OPENING_PRESETS loop renders two side-by-side TouchableOpacitys with testIDs wall-opening-preset-${id} and label + size subtext. Clean. The preset opening is spread into openings via `{...preset.opening}` — correct immutability.
/app/frontend/src/sketch/wallArea.ts:104-107 — OPENING_PRESETS constant: 'Tür' 0,885m × 2,01m (= 1.78 rounded m²), 'Fenster' 1,00m × 1,20m (= 1.20 m²). Values match spec exactly.

/app/frontend/src/sketch/wallArea.ts:79-101 — hasWallHeights checks either global wall.height > 0 OR any segment.height > 0. segmentNumberPositions returns midpoint shifted by offset toward centroid, with correct sign flip via dot product. Line indexing uses (i + 1) for the number label — matches 'Linie x von n' in the panel.

/app/frontend/src/sketch/sketchSvg.ts:455-460 — renders <circle r="9" fill="#fff" stroke="#5d4037"/> + brown bold number ONLY when hasWallHeights(polygonWalls[el.id]) is true. Preview SVG for polygons without wall heights correctly omits the circles. Verified via localStorage decode: 4 circles present for the polygon with wall-height-all='2,50m'.

/app/frontend/app/sketches/draw.tsx:5347-5357 — in-editor line numbers rendered as SVG G/Circle/SvgText with inverse zoom scaling (Math.max(5, 9/numberScale) for radius, Math.max(6, 10/numberScale) for fontSize) → stays readable when zoomed. Gating `(hasSelectedSegment || hasWallHeights(polygonWalls[element.id]))` matches spec exactly.

/app/frontend/app/sketches/draw.tsx:7643-7646 — panel body is ScrollView only when isPhoneDevice; testID 'line-measure-scroll' with maxHeight = screenHeight - insets - 190. Verified present on 390-wide / absent on 768-wide. The -190 reserve is slightly too small when numpad + Cancel/Add are stacked below (see ui_bug).
/app/frontend/app/sketches/draw.tsx — still 9961 lines (carry-over from iter 63-65). Splitting the floating measure panel into its own component remains pending.
testIDs still missing: line-measure-done-button / line-measure-cancel-button / arrow-tool-button (carry-over).

rca_of_issue: Phone-panel buttons out of fold: the 390x844 panel is positioned with the body as a ScrollView bounded by maxHeight = screenHeight - insets - 190 at draw.tsx:7645. On a 844-px tall phone with top safe-area ~0 and bottom insets ~0, maxHeight ≈ 654. The header (~30), body (529 px actual), ABC/numpad grid (~220) and the Cancel/Add row (~50) together total ~830 px, which combined with the ~50-px top offset of the panel exceeds 844 by ~20 px — exactly matching the observed bottoms 864/863. Mitigation: (1) subtract 220-230 instead of 190 in the maxHeight formula, or (2) refactor the Cancel/Add row out of the panel's scrollable region into a sticky absolute-positioned footer, so the inner ScrollView can shrink while the buttons remain anchored at the bottom of the viewport.
